48.
(1) The powers, duties and functions pertaining to
the registration of security rights of movable property shall
be exercised, performed and discharged by the Board.
(2) The Bureau shall, for the purpose of this Act, establish,
maintain and operate a register to be called and known as
the  Register  of  Security  Rights  in  Movable  Property
